plan.title: Scholarship Application Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of applicant demographics, status, and geographic distribution

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Approved'

panels.title: Avg Marks %
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applicants by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applicants by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Districts by Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS total_applicants, AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks, AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative:
